latestVersion.changelog:
Elite Copywriter skill v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a structured, professional copywriting system for marketing, executive, and customer-facing content.
- Enforces strict prompts to always gather context and apply conversion-tested frameworks before writing.
- Offers a detailed process for context gathering, framework selection, and storytelling integration.
- Provides an explicit quality checklist and editing guidelines for all output.
- Lists scenarios for when to use (and not use) the skill and explains key copywriting frameworks and principles supported.
